test_ONE_GPU_CASES: test the one GPU diffusion test cases for text-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-image modalities
test_TWO_GPU_CASES: test the two GPU diffusion test cases with tensor parallelism and ring attention configurations
run_test_cases: run the GPU test cases with DiffusionTestCase entries using DiffusionServerArgs and sampling params
build_test_case: build a DiffusionTestCase with a name, DiffusionServerArgs, and sampling params for a diffusion model
configure_server_args: configure DiffusionServerArgs with model path, parallelism degree, and LoRA support options
